provenance: Official Microsoft Android Maven AAR (1.23.2). iOS: Microsoft's CocoaPods archive hosts are gone (onnxruntimepackages.z14.web.core.windows.net 404, download.onnxruntime.ai serves a non-matching *.azureedge.net certificate and 404s, github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime 404s), so the 1.23.0 pod archive pinned on 2026-11-09 can no longer be retrieved. On 2026-11-22 iOS was re-pinned to 1.23.2, the same version as Android: the official NuGet package Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime 1.23.2 (source_sha256) ships runtimes/ios/native/onnxruntime.xcframework.zip, repackaged unmodified in the CocoaPods layout (onnxruntime.xcframework, Headers/*.h copied from the framework, LICENSE) and hosted as a GitHub Release asset of CrispStrobe/onnxruntime-spm. Its C header is byte-identical to the pinned API-23 header. Notices are the unchanged pinned bytes, identical in the official onnxruntime 1.23.0 and 1.23.2 PyPI wheels, hosted on the same release because raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/onnxruntime 404s. Full application and tiny Add-model execution remain required.
